# Vendored code

## qrcode.js

- Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator (npm qrcode-generator 1.4.4)
- Author: Kazuhiko Arase
- Licence: MIT

Used to render the install QR code entirely in the browser. Vendored instead of
loaded from a CDN so the studio keeps working offline and never tells a third party
which URL, or which local address, is being shown.

Only this unmodified file is copied. Its licence text is reproduced in
LICENSE-qrcode.txt.
